place.title: Place {ref} (hall sensor)
place.text: Push {ref}'s 4 pins into column f, one pin per row: A0 into {hole.ao}, G into {hole.gnd}, + into {hole.vcc}, D0 into {hole.do}. The black sensor at the top points up, away from the breadboard.
place.tip: Read the labels printed next to the pins. If yours are in another order, follow the labels, not the picture. A0 gets no wire.

why: {ref} has a Hall sensor that feels magnetic fields; when a magnet comes close enough (set with its screw), it switches its D0 output and its second LED changes.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s GND pin to ground.
wire.power: This powers {ref} from 3.3 V, so its outputs are never more than the Pico's 3.3 V.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}'s D0 output: it changes while a magnet is near. The module drives this line itself.
